laterality_contract.rule: Laterality is descriptive only and uses the frozen family-specific annotation field. Same/opposite annotation side is not a claim about synaptic compartment location, functional ipsilateral/contralateral drive, or delay. Unknown side remains unknown.

allowed: Report exact MaleCNS v1.0 structural edges among the frozen Gate A candidate bodies.
Report aggregate structural weights by candidate family and frozen annotation side.
State whether each prespecified family-to-family structural path is present or absent.
forbidden: Structural weight is equivalent to physiological synaptic strength.
An il3LN6 edge is inhibitory without an independent transmitter/sign audit.
Same/opposite annotation side proves ipsilateral/contralateral synaptic action.
Structural connectivity establishes the measured delay or odor-motion computation.
This audit supports navigation or source-finding performance claims.

stop_rules: Stop if the regenerated Gate A report SHA-256 differs from the frozen value.
Stop if the annotation SHA-256 differs from Gate A.
Stop if selected candidate identities or counts differ from Gate A.
Do not add candidates based on the weight table.
Do not change required structural paths after inspecting the weight table.
Do not promote structural laterality to functional inhibitory direction without a separate sign/physiology gate.
